name: Moose — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Moose from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Moose" but are not part of the Moose entry, which is unchanged.

MOOSE
CR 3

These towering ruminant herbivores graze on high-hanging leaves, especially from acacia trees. They are swift runners though with a gangly gait and prefer to flee from predators if possible but can kick with considerable strength if cornered.

Feats Endurance, Run
Skills Perception +9

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Knockdown (Ex)

A moose can attempt a trip combat maneuver as a free action against a Small or Medium creature it hits with its antlers on a charge attack or with a critical hit. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Stomp (Ex)

When adjacent to a prone creature, a moose can make one hooves attack against that creature as a swift action.

Wide Rack (Ex)

If two Small or Medium foes are adjacent, the moose can make one gore attack against each of them as a full-round action.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold forests
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

These towering ruminant herbivores graze on highhanging leaves, especially from acacia trees. They are swift runners though with a gangly gait and prefer to flee from predators if possible but can kick with considerable strength if cornered.
